Name: Sanrio Plushies
Author: otohimexoxo
Description:
. ☆  . • ☆ . ° .• °:. *₊ ° . ☆

[img]https://imgur.com/V93CvTp.png[/img]
1. download and install alternative textures or content patcher
2. download this mod
3. unzip contents into stardew's mod folder

[img]https://imgur.com/e6yXfxu.png[/img]
♡ how to use: purchase the paint bucket from robin and use it on the large futan bear to change it to any sanrio plushie of your choosing
♡ includes 3 variations of hello kitty, 3 variations of my melody, 2 variations of kuromi, cinnamoroll, cappuccino, espresso, mocha, chiffon, keroppi, pompompurin, tuxedo sam, chococat, badtz-maru, pochacco, bonbonribbon, primausa, balletusa, usahana, corocorokuririn, strawberryusa, blueberryusa, kurousa, shirousa and cogimyun
♡ sprites made by me
